Definition: `ED` and `ED-TAI`: The numer of days after calving when estrus detection begin .`TAI`: this value will be ignored: set to 0.
The fraction of estrous cows that would be detected in the `ED` and `ED-TAI` protocols. `TAI` protocol : set to 0.
The proportion (%) of cows conceiving after estrus is detected in  `ED` and `ED-TAI`. `TAI` protocol: set to 0.
`TAI` : Presynchronization program used before first breeding cows. `ED` or `ED-TAI`: set to `None`.
`TAI` :Day after calving when the first hormone treatment of the presynch program occurs. `ED` or `ED-TAI` set to 0.
`TAI` and `ED-TAI`: OvSynch program to be used for cows. `ED`: set to `null`

Day the OvSynch program begins. `TAI`: if a presynch program is used, OvSynch will not begin until presynch is complete.`ED-TAI`: OvSynch begins on this day if estrus has not been detected after the voluntary waiting period. `ED` : this value is ignored.
`TAI` and `ED-TAI`: conception rate for the OvSynch program. `ED`: set to 0.
`TAI` and `ED-TAI`: resynchronization program used relative to the first pregnancy check. `ED`: set to `null`. **See note below
